pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take: **Gunner's draft strategy must be a secret only his barber knows, 'cause he somehow leads with DR Congo in the mix.** Man's sittin' pretty at the top while Devin's ghost pepper wasn't spicy enough to avoid that Belgium blunder. Devin's boys in red and yellow got straight up cooked by Belgium, yet he managed to snatch up a slick win with Spain over Portugal—bailin' him out like an extra-time goal. Meanwhile, "The Backpass Assassin" Gayden's lineup, led by England, ain't backin' nothin' but heartbreaks, sittin' in third, huffin' and puffin' with 39 points. Then there's "Mustard Boy" Zach, hangin' on with 35 points – he probably thought Saudi Arabia was stockpiling goals, not oil. Down at the bottom, Rafe "The Noisemaker," pickin' teams like he's throwin' darts blindfolded, can't make sense of it all. I'm callin' it now: if his Germany squad doesn't get their act together, that 29 points he's collectin' is gonna age like milk. Predicting Atlanta's matchup, I reckon whoever's got the stronger bench will take it, but if y'all expectin' exact scores from me, you must be havin' a laugh!
